title: Calculator Menu
hints: Print the menu before the loop, so it appears only once.
Read the option first. Only read the line with two numbers for options 1 to 4, because 0 and invalid options have no numbers after them.
Declare int operations = 0; before the loop, and add 1 only when a result was printed (not for a division by zero).
Use break (in a while (true) loop) or a do … while (!option.equals("0")) loop to stop at 0.

mustContain.message: Use a loop to keep the menu running.
Use a switch or if/else to handle the options.
